conventions.convention: Principal bundles carry a right action, with equivariant smooth product charts; manifolds are boundaryless by default. Empty bases and total spaces are allowed.

A connection is a specified smooth right-invariant complement TP = VP ⊕ H. Curvature is vertical-valued, with sign K_H(X,Y) = −v([hX,hY]); no connection-existence assertion is made. Countable choice is assumed through the tangent-bundle and vector-field conventions.
Gauge transformations are equivariant smooth diffeomorphisms covering the identity, with multiplication given by composition; no topology or Lie-group structure on the gauge group is specified.

Connections transform by pushforward, giving a left action. Associated bundles use [pg,v] = [p,ρ(g)v], and sections transform by postcomposition with the induced automorphism. The representation is finite-dimensional, smooth, and real.

load_bearing.statement: A smooth right principal G-bundle is a topological right principal G-bundle with smooth projection and right action whose principal charts can be chosen as equivariant diffeomorphisms.

Assume AC_omega. A principal connection is a smooth right-invariant horizontal complement to VP = ker(dπ); its vertical-valued curvature is K_H(X,Y) = −v([hX,hY]), a smooth alternating bundle map TP ×_P TP → VP.
The gauge group consists of smooth diffeomorphisms Φ:P→P satisfying π∘Φ=π and Φ(pg)=Φ(p)g, under composition.

Assume AC_omega. For a smooth right principal G-bundle with connection H and Φ in its gauge group, Φ_*H=dΦ(H) is a principal connection and K_{Φ_*H}(dΦ_pX,dΦ_pY)=dΦ_p(K_H(X,Y)). Composition gives a left action on principal connections.

For a smooth right principal G-bundle and a smooth representation on a finite-dimensional real vector space, [p,v]↦[Φ(p),v] defines a smooth vector-bundle automorphism. The assignment preserves composition and identities and gives a linear left action on smooth sections by postcomposition.
